content:
Today Apple announced that iOS 27 will officially launch next Monday, September 14. Below are the complete release notes for this iPhone update.

Apple's official iOS 27 release notes are now available for reference

Apple has today released the complete iOS 27 release notes alongside the RC update. Below is the original text:

Siri AI (available on all iPhone 16 models and later, iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max)

  • A more capable and conversational version of Siri is officially rolling out, with users to receive the update gradually. The new Siri can help you find the information you need and accomplish more tasks, leveraging personal context understanding, App actions, on-screen awareness, and rich world knowledge.
  • The new voice experience offers a more expressive and natural voice, and through powerful on-device models on iPhone Air and iPhone 17 Pro or later models, allows you to customise Siri's tone and rhythm to better match your personal style.
  • A dedicated Siri app lets you easily review past conversations or start new ones, with conversations privately synced across your Apple devices via iCloud.
  • Siri mode in Camera integrates Visual Intelligence into the Camera app, letting you ask questions about or perform actions on what you're seeing, such as splitting a bill or checking the nutritional information of a dish.
  • “Write with Siri” lets you draft from scratch, edit existing content, or get feedback from Siri almost anywhere you input text. In Messages and Mail, Siri adjusts writing style based on your relationship with the recipient, drawing on the unique words and punctuation you've used in past conversations with them.

Apple Intelligence across Apps (available on all iPhone 16 models and later, iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max)

  • Spatial re-composition in Photos lets you adjust framing after taking a photo by virtually changing the shooting position; the “Expand” tool can intelligently extend images beyond their original borders and fill them with realistic content, letting you straighten the horizon, change aspect ratio, or add more space around your subject; the “Clean Up” feature supports removing larger objects with more realistic, high-quality results—you can choose Quick mode for small blemishes or High Quality mode for more precise edits.
  • Safari's “Organise by Topic” uses Apple Intelligence to organise your tabs, analysing web page content and automatically grouping similar tabs; “Notify Me” periodically checks web pages for updates, such as price changes or product availability; “Describe Extensions” lets you create custom extensions using natural language, adjusting how you browse or format website content.
  • The all-new Image Playground uses a brand-new generative model capable of producing high-quality images in nearly any style, including photorealistic styles; you can modify images through touch and natural language, generate lock screen wallpapers and contact posters, with personalised suggestions.
  • “Describe Shortcuts” lets you create shortcuts using natural language, or refine existing shortcuts.
  • Summary activity notifications in Home consolidate relevant alerts from multiple accessories into a single notification; HomeKit Secure Video recordings can have their content summarised for eligible iCloud+ subscribers; camera clip search lets you search for specific moments captured by HomeKit Secure Video through the Home app or Spotlight when using an eligible iCloud+ plan.
  • “Describe Events” in Calendar lets you create activities using natural language, with details such as time, location, attendees, and event title automatically filled in by Apple Intelligence.
  • Suggestions in Mail can provide corresponding actions based on email content, such as providing directions to a restaurant you've booked.
  • Call context in the Phone app understands when you're speaking with certain businesses and proactively pulls relevant information from different apps, such as confirmation numbers or booking references.
  • Accessibility: VoiceOver has enhanced, more detailed and contextual image understanding for photos, charts, and screenshots, and offers a conversational experience letting you ask questions about the screen or surroundings, with new ways to get quick answers integrated through the Action button; the enhanced Magnifier delivers conversational visual assistance for low-vision users, with a high-contrast interface and natural language App control for zooming and other Magnifier functions; a smarter Accessibility Reader uses intelligent technology to provide better text cleanup and formatting, image and table handling, on-demand summaries, and translation; flexible input for Voice Control lets you operate the device with your voice simply by describing on-screen elements in your own words, such as “tap the gear” or “tap the top-right button”.
  • Even more features, including more ways to create and modify Genmoji, automatic proofreading, and more accurate voice input powered by on-device models on iPhone Air and iPhone 17 Pro or later models.

Child Safety

  • An improved setup experience for new children's accounts lets parents choose which specific Apps their child can access when setting up their iPhone.
  • “Request Browsing Approval” lets parents choose to approve each new website before their child browses it.
  • Expanded Communication Safety protections help intervene before children see gore or violence in shared photos or videos.
  • “Usage Time Limits” helps parents set time limits for their child's Apps in categories such as entertainment, gaming, and social media, with tailored recommendations based on expert research for children of different ages.
  • “Schedule” lets parents choose which Apps their child can access during different times of the day, weekdays, and weekends.
  • The redesigned Screen Time settings give parents an at-a-glance overview of their child's device usage, with access permissions adjustable in just a few taps.

System Improvements

  • Optimisations to Liquid Glass improve overall readability, with a new slider in Settings letting you personalise the appearance from extra clear to fully tinted.
  • A smoother experience across the system, including improvements to App launch, loading of new photos in the Photos library, and AirDrop transfer speeds.
  • More relevant and comprehensive search results in Spotlight, Photos, and Mail.
  • Connectivity Assist makes switching between Wi-Fi and mobile networks smoother.
  • More cross-app and experience improvements, including enhanced iCloud Shared Albums in Photos, custom EQ for AirPods, new support for perimenopause and menopause in Cycle Tracking in the Health app, and separate volume settings for alarms and timers.

For information about the security content of Apple software updates, please visit: https://support.apple.com/100100

Some features may not be available in all regions or on all iPhone models. For details, please visit: https://www.apple.com/ios/feature-availability/

Some Apple Intelligence features may have usage restrictions. For details, please visit: https://www.apple.com/apple-intelligence

New features and improvements added in software updates like this one may affect performance and/or battery life. For details, please visit: https://support.apple.com/125039

iOS 27 has many more new features not listed here. You can read our full coverage of iOS 27 features here.
